scope: Read-only diagnosis of the running, original GP-MSF smoke; no queue/process/code/threshold mutation

ap_summary.reason: 450-iter smoke has no validation; not an AP experiment

bounds_assumptions: For each head/query K=4 radar candidates; support_rate is mean valid candidates
All unsupported head/queries have null weight exactly 1
Non-null weight is in [0,1]; hence s <= v <= min(K*s,1) and a <= v
Conditional null mean = 1-a/v; it is not equal to the global null mean
Image level masks are identical across levels, so the sum of mean beta_img is the valid candidate-height fraction
unproven: GT-region evidence coverage, conditioned null, same-object support, residual magnitude
AP benefit or failure of correctly assembled GP-MSF; no validation exists
findings: Message assembly reshapes [B,heads,queries,head_dim] directly into [B,embed_dim,queries], mixing spatial/channel axes
Only an in-memory permutation correction makes a nonzero-projection chunk-size equivalence probe pass
The existing T8 test keeps output projections zero and cannot detect message assembly defects
Increasing query_chunk before repairing axes changes the implemented model, not only runtime
High global null means do not establish high conditional refusal in available/GT regions
The resource overrun is measured; attribution to pure arithmetic compute has not been measured

final_verdict.failure: ValueError('matched resource budget exceeded 1.20x; manual review required')
